# Ozmotic Learning

> Ozmotic Learning is an innovative educational projector system designed to integrate learning content into bedtime routines through pre-sleep memory consolidation.

Ozmotic Learning combines hardware (ceiling projector) with a mobile app to deliver educational content during the pre-sleep window when the brain is optimized for memory consolidation. The platform focuses on early childhood development through scientifically-backed sleep-learning techniques.

## Key Topics

- Pre-sleep learning
- Memory consolidation
- Sleep-based learning
- Educational projector
- Bedtime routine
- Neuroplasticity
- Early childhood development
- Phonics education
- Ozmotic Learning Projector
- Ozmotic Learning App
- Relaxation content
- Educational content
- Pavlovian conditioning
- 30-night guarantee
- Ceiling projector technology
